E37 and E39 are shipped with BLANK item_text: S5 labels E37 'Access from different devices' (interoperability) and E39 'Different data hosting options' (data security), but the paper's elimination narrative, reproduced numerically from the live data, says the step-2 drop (0.479/0.611) was a data-security item and the step-3 pair (r=0.610/0.556, 0.541/0.501) were both interoperability; live data put E37 as the step-2 drop (0.48/0.61) and E38+E39 as the step-3 pair (0.61/0.56, 0.54/0.50). S5 and the paper therefore disagree on E37 vs E39, and nothing available decides which is right, so neither descriptor is shipped. OPTIONS: the paper gives the 7-point anchors in English only ('very much disagree' = 1 to 'very much agree' = 7, confirmed by Figure 1/2 captions 'A score of 1 means very much disagree and 7 very much agree'); the administered Spanish anchors are not in S3 or any supplement, so option_text is English for 1 and 7 with option_text_translated empty, and 2-6 are blank (no labels published). Rows emitted for every resp level each item's respondents used (141 rows).
